title: Bubblegum Telephone
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Bright triangle-wave melodies in G mixolydian give this track a bubbly, carefree character over a snappy Casio RZ-1 groove. The hook layers a stepping bass figure with an octave-doubled lead and a slow, reverb-drenched counter-melody that drifts in from the right side of the mix.
code:
setcpm(115/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.85),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)),
    note("<g4 b4 d5 b4>").s("triangle").attack(0.01).decay(0.2).sustain(0.3).release(0.2).gain(0.7).room(0.4).delay(0.3).lpf(1600)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*2 [~ bd] bd").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.9),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.6).room(0.25),
    note("<g2 g2 e2 d2>*4").s("triangle").lpf(saw.slow(24).range(500, 1800)).decay(0.15).sustain(0.2).gain(0.7),
    n("0 2 4 2 ~ 4 5 4").scale("G4:mixolydian").s("triangle").attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.25).gain(0.72).room(0.3).delay(0.25)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*2 [~ bd] bd").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.95),
    s("hh*8").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.65).room(0.25),
    s("~ ~ ~ rim").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.45),
    note("<g2 g2 e2 d2>*4").s("triangle").lpf(1500).decay(0.15).sustain(0.2).gain(0.72),
    n("0 2 4 2 ~ 4 5 7").scale("G4:mixolydian").s("triangle").attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.3).gain(0.78).room(0.3).delay(0.25).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)),
    n("<7 9 7 4>").scale("G4:mixolydian").s("triangle").gain(0.5).room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.5").pan(0.7)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.8),
    note("<[g3,b3,d4] [e3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3] [d3,fs3,a3]>").s("triangle").attack(0.05).decay(0.4).sustain(0.5).release(0.6).gain(0.6).room(0.55).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(800, 2200)),
    n("0 ~ 4 ~ 2 ~ ~ 5").scale("G4:mixolydian").s("triangle").gain(0.55).room(0.5).delay(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7))
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*2 [~ bd] bd").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.98),
    s("hh*8").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.52).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).cut(1).degradeBy(0.12),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.68).room(0.25),
    s("~ ~ ~ rim").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.5).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("<g2 g2 e2 d2>*4").s("triangle").lpf(1800).decay(0.15).sustain(0.2).gain(0.75),
    n("0 2 4 2 ~ 4 5 7").scale("G4:mixolydian").s("triangle").attack(0.01).decay(0.18).sustain(0.3).gain(0.8).room(0.3).delay(0.25).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.45)),
    n("<7 9 11 9>").scale("G4:mixolydian").s("triangle").gain(0.55).room(0.5).delay(".4:.166:.5").pan(0.7).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.82),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.45).pan(sine.range(0.35, 0.65)),
    note("<g4 b4 d5 b4>").s("triangle").attack(0.01).decay(0.2).sustain(0.3).release(0.3).gain(0.65).room(0.45).delay(0.3).lpf(1400)
  )]
)
